profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is recorded as a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and a company website at rolls-royce.com. The text drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce as a developer and deliverer of complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, saying it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years and that it describes its purpose as meeting the planet's vital power needs.

The site material covers manufacturing and partnership news rather than AI products. It states that Rolls-Royce invested 300 million pounds in UK manufacturing and engineering facilities to drive aerospace and defence growth, completed a $1 Billion investment in Indiana tied to engine manufacturing and test campuses in Indianapolis, announced with Reliance Industries a strategic intent to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, and agreed with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency to co-operate on advanced nuclear technologies.

The held record lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for this company. Its law exposure is recorded under Nevada with a count of zero.
